model_rules: package manifests are generated from checked-in stdlib and showcase source surfaces
every locked package carries language version, ABI identity, source digest, manifest digest, and local trust metadata
dependency edges resolve only through the checked-in local registry model and carry checked-in source authority plus digest metadata
local registry entries carry exact locked version selection, dependency edge digests, fail-closed hosted/network policy, and replay evidence
the lock carries a deterministic dependency-first resolution plan that local registry indexes and clean installs must preserve exactly
package manifests, lock package rows, and local registry entries carry the same module graph source-of-truth record derived from checked-in stdlib module inventory or showcase portfolio inputs

manifest trust signatures are recomputed from explicit signature envelopes that bind package id, namespace, source digest, manifest digest, package version, language version, ABI identity, trust root, signing key, and revocation policy before lock acceptance
ABI and language requirements on dependency edges must match the target package before a lock can be accepted
dependency version requirements, resolved versions, source authority digests, target source digests, and target manifest digests must match the locked target package

revoked packages, signature drift, digest drift, missing provenance, missing or unsafe module graph metadata, unsafe dependency source authority, dependency cycles, hosted registry claims, and network resolution claims fail closed
claim_boundary: local package create-lock-build-install model backed by generated manifests, deterministic locks, offline mirrors, local registry indexes, and install/restore receipts; hosted registry and arbitrary network dependency resolution remain unsupported
